title: PII redaction
one_line: Strip emails, phone numbers, card numbers and keys before anything is stored.
verified_against: Rust core unit tests and the native binding tests (bindings/python/tests) run the real sanitizer; the facade tests in tests/ use a mock core. Needs the compiled core.
snippet:
from briefcase.sanitize import Sanitizer

result = Sanitizer().sanitize("email me at jane@acme.com")
print(result.sanitized)
